hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: liquid-universe companies whose latest annual 10-K is filed abnormally early versus their own trailing filing-lag norm may drift up over the next 10 trading days, because prompt disclosure proxies clean books / management confidence and the market underreacts to the timeliness signal. Tested with a light liquidity gate only, no SPY-relative momentum confirmation.
locked_variables: abnormally-early annual-report filing (filed-lag below the company own trailing-average lag) as a standalone next-open 10-day candidate-pool source

prediction.confidence_reason: Mechanism: the SEC filing-delay/timeliness anomaly (Griffin 2003; late filers underperform) is a documented, production-visible (EDGAR filed date vs fiscal-year end), PIT-safe event distinct from the accepted filing-RECENCY freshness support (exp-20260528-016) and from the frozen Companyfacts relief/overhang ratio family. Disconfirmer: recent quality pools (SBC exp-20260616-015, CapEx exp-20260617-007, accruals exp-20260614-020) were aggregate-positive but failed old_thin chop and drawdown; dropping the price-confirmation gate could either expose a chop-robust event edge or just add noise, and early-filing events may be too thin/seasonal to clear the sample and concentration gates.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV (no momentum gate)
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual 10-K filing history, fewer than 3 prior annual filings, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT annual 10-K filed-lag history, abnormally-early-vs-own-norm gate, light liquidity gate, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The SEC filing-timeliness early-disclosure event source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: aggregate_ev_not_positive, aggregate_pnl_not_positive, window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, target_sample_too_small, drawdown_drift_too_high, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). DECISIVE CAVEAT: this scout harness is CORE-universe-scoped (~47 names; only 36 had filing history), so an event-driven source that fires roughly once per company per year produced only ~18 paper trades and old_thin was dominated by one or two losing core-name trades. The broad-universe edge is the part that matters and was NOT tested here: across the ~1,137 liquid-universe names with >=3 prior 10-Ks there are ~1,713 abnormally-early-filing events all-time (~202 old_thin, ~29 mid_weak, ~248 late_strong by filed date). On the thin core universe the signal is negative/under-powered; it is neither confirmed nor refuted at breadth. It is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta -0.0297; aggregate PnL delta $-1,263.37; max drawdown drift +0.0077; 18 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping earliness-days, current-lag cap, prior-filing-count, event-age, price/ADV liquidity floors, FY duration, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on the CORE universe. The only sanctioned next step is the same fixed gate over the BROAD liquid universe (candidate_universe=broad_market), since this run never tested breadth.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: The binding limitation is harness scope, not (yet) signal quality: this scout replays candidates only over the core ~47-name universe, which starves an event-driven source. The genuinely informative next test is the SAME fixed filing-timeliness gate run over the BROAD liquid universe via a candidate_universe=broad_market path (as the accepted SBC/compression/distribution shared sleeves do), where ~1,713 early-filing events exist, then judged on the canonical three windows and the accepted comparators. Only after a broad-universe replay should earliness/lag thresholds be considered, and any promotion still needs a shared helper + parity. Do NOT conclude filing-timeliness is dead from this thin core-universe run, and do NOT sweep thresholds on the core universe; if broad-universe replay is also negative, a valid retry needs a materially different disclosure-timing field (quarterly 10-Q timeliness, accelerated-filer-status change, NT 10-K late-filing notices) or closed forward replacement-value rows.
